title: Completed scalar insertion transported to the canonical module pullback unit
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian adic coefficient ring with datum $d$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], let $g:X\to Y$ be any scheme morphism, and let $R_X,R_Y$ be its completed coefficient sheaves. Use the published completed ordinary pullback $G$ [def-weil-pbc-pulled-reduction-comparison-data] and canonical identified-coefficient module pullback $F$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. For any equality $h:G=F$, any $R_Y$-module sheaf $M$, any object $Z$ of the small pro-etale site of $Y$, and any section $x\in M(Z)$, the component of $\operatorname{eqToIso}(h)$ sends the published scalar-insertion section of $G(M)$ over $g^{-1}Z$ to the section $\eta_M(x)$ of $F(M)$, where $\eta$ is the canonical module pullback/direct-image adjunction unit.

proof.text: The projection-defined coefficient map agrees with integralRingIso.hom because every finite projection agrees. The ordinary completed pullback is inverse image followed by the chosen scalar extension. The object and map equalities of the published scalar extension identify its equality transport with the natural object-equality comparison. Proof irrelevance makes this independent of h.

proof.text: The sheafified tensor normalization sends the insertion to 1 tensor the inverse-image adjunction-unit section. The canonical ringed module adjunction is the composite inverse-image and scalar-extension adjunction, whose unit has exactly this value. Evaluation at the identity base-change map removes the presheaf restriction by map_id. Thus the transported sections coincide.

lean.statement:
theorem completedInsertionUnit
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y)
    (h : completedModulePullback g d =
      proEtaleRingModulePullback g (d.completedRing Y) (d.completedRing X)
        (d.integralRingIso g))
    (M : reductionModules Y (d.completedRing Y)) (Z : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
    (x : M.val.obj Z) :
    ((eqToIso h).hom.app M).val.app ((proEtaleBaseChange g).op.obj Z)
        (PulledReduction.insertion d g M Z x) =
      ((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g (d.completedRing Y) (d.completedRing X)
        (d.integralRingIso g)).unit.app M).val.app Z x
